entity: Messrs. R. C. Barkley and R. C. Moores, II, District Geologists, Continental Oil Company
summary: Messrs. R. C. Barkley and R. C. Moores, II, District Geologists at Continental Oil Company, objected to the draft ORV environmental statement on the grounds that it made little provision for the productive use of vehicles in mineral exploration and mining. Their comments were part of a broader group of mining-industry responses opposing restrictions on vehicles used for resource extraction on public lands. The Department ultimately responded by excepting mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the off-road vehicle definition in the final statement.
summary_quote: Messrs. R. C. Barkley and R. C. Moores, II, District Geologists, Continental Oil Company - stated that little provision had been made for productive use of vehicles in exploration and development of mineral exploration and mining.
